content.text: Why did you guys decide to have Gardy pre-workout versus post?
there’s a pretty good split of managers doing it pre workout and post workout - predicated on schedules
A couple of the media told us today they like him doing it early because they don’t have to rush home to catch his zoom call...
So why don’t you guys try it right after the workout, boom.
And let us know to make it snappy. I’m sure we’d comply if we could get some quotes on Torkelson
It helps us do our jobs a lot more effectively, though. I’m writing about Mize and Torkelson with no quotes
All I’m saying is try it one of these days, why not?
So what time are you planning on having Gardy then???
And we’re going to get 10-1 p.m. every day
(I’m not picking bones here, whatever Gardy says goes, he gets that call, but I’m just saying.)
I have little use for Zimmermann and Greiner when I’m writing about Mize and Torkelson
And Gardy talks at 9 a.m., before anything even happens for the day
Either way, you guys have done a great job so far. I’m sure things will evolve as we go on. Enjoy the rest of the day
